assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Site and key-area polygons are provisional repository constraints derived from public textual scope; they are not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All boundary-sensitive geometry, area metrics, figures, drawings, and spatial claims require a package-wide recalculation after official GIS/CAD data is cleared.

assumptions.statement: Every AI service scenario requires a named human owner, a pause condition, an appeal channel, and a review record before any public pilot.
assumptions.impact: The proposal does not authorize deployment, personal-data collection, or autonomous decisions.
